name: STEER
description: You annotate a draft where the prose has gone limp, save it, and the rewrite comes back honouring those annotations rather than a general sense of improvement. Requires you to know what is wrong with your own writing; it follows marks, it does not diagnose.

official.title: STEER by Bill
official.description: A writing desk for killing AI slop. Mark a draft, Save, and get a rewrite that follows the marks.
